description: Race column stores self‑identified ethnic group as a categorical string. All 30 records are non‑null with 6 distinct values. Observed values include 'Chinese', 'Indian', 'Malay' in various capitalisations (e.g., 'MALAY', 'malay', 'indian'), indicating inconsistent casing.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardise case to title case for race categories: 'MALAY' → 'Malay', 'malay' → 'Malay', 'indian' → 'Indian'.
[CLARIFY] Confirm the official list of allowed race categories and whether any additional standardisation (e.g., handling of synonyms) is required.
